en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a canal or narrow harbor basin flanked by stone buildings with balconies and shuttered windows. A small bridge or gate-like structure spans the water in the background, with hills visible beyond. Greek handwritten text appears in the lower left, and the year 1918 is printed nearby. A modern website watermark, "www.elia.org.gr," is overlaid across the lower right.
